# Dehancer

> > Professional film emulation plugins for DaVinci Resolve, Photoshop, and Lightroom, bringing authentic analog aesthetics to digital color grading workflows.

Dehancer provides industry-standard film emulation tools featuring authentic film grain, halation, and color profiles from classic film stocks like Kodak Vision3 and Gold 200. The platform also hosts the Dehancer Colourist Awards, a worldwide competition celebrating excellence in cinematic color grading.

## Key Topics

- Film emulation
- Color grading
